Carnage Heart EXA.name: Carnage Heart EXA
Carnage Heart EXA.summary: A follow-up to the cult classic, Carnage Heart EXA puts players in control of giant robots - Overkill Engines (OKEs) - and pits these menacing mechs against each other in larger-than-life battles! You can control your OKE yourself or set up complex programs that automatically command your robo-battlers to follow your orders to the letter. Choose from either a compelling Story Mode, or get right into the action with Battle Mode!

Mai-HiME - Bakuretsu! Fuuka Gakuen Gekit.name: Mai-Hime Bakuretsu! Fuuka Gakuen Gekitoushi?!
Mai-HiME - Bakuretsu! Fuuka Gakuen Gekit.summary: A 3D fighting game based on the My-Hime anime series. Its story mode retells the the first 16 episodes using stills and clips from the show.

Rapala Pro Bass Fishing.name: Rapala Pro Bass Fishing
Rapala Pro Bass Fishing.summary: With Rapala Pro Bass Fishing you get the ultimate fishing experience. Compete against real life pro fishermen in authentic tournament action and prove you're the best of the best!

Shepherd's Crossing.name: Shepherd's Crossing
Shepherd's Crossing.summary:
This game allows players to build a farm and hunt for treasures.
Even though the game is not as much open as other farming games, players will be able to fight off other creatures in turn-based battle.

Tantei Opera - Milky Holmes 2.name: Tantei Opera Milky Holmes 2
Tantei Opera - Milky Holmes 2.summary: A sequel to Tantei Opera Milky Holmes.
